brief.greeting: Good morning. AMD finally got its turn on the llama.cpp leaderboard, and the numbers look less like a sprint and more like a jog.

stories.headline: Llama.cpp adds AMD Ryzen and Radeon support
stories.body: **New performance window opens:** the llama.cpp dashboard now tracks inference speed on AMD Ryzen CPUs and Radeon GPUs, letting you compare against the usual Nvidia baseline.
stories.why: You can spot hardware bottlenecks before they bite your production runs.

stories.headline: Thursday updates patch kernel and key packages
stories.body: **Patch Tuesday arrives early:** AlmaLinux, Debian, Fedora, Mageia and Oracle all received kernel upgrades plus nginx 1.26 and Ruby 4.0, tightening the attack surface across the stack.
stories.why: Up‑to‑date packages keep your servers from becoming easy targets.

stories.headline: Inkling‑2‑Mini‑Strata hits nearly 3K downloads
stories.body: **Community love spikes:** the Strata‑engine Inkling‑2‑Mini‑Strata model logged 2,965 downloads and 254 likes on Hugging Face, showing strong interest in compact image‑text‑to‑text tools.
stories.why: High download counts signal a model worth testing in low‑resource pipelines.

quick_hits.text: **Modular 6502:** a plug‑in board revives the classic microprocessor for hobbyists.
**Print‑your‑flap:** a DIY split‑flap display lets you recreate airport signage at home.
**Gecko weather:** a sensor kit monitors temperature and humidity for reptile terrariums.
**Fridge fix:** step‑by‑step guide to revive a dead ice maker in an LG fridge.

brief.sign_off: That’s it—keep coding, keep curious, and enjoy the bugs (the good kind).

highlights.title: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
highlights.summary: The llama.cpp benchmark dashboard now supports performance tracking on AMD Ryzen CPUs and Radeon GPUs.
highlights.detail: The dashboard visualizes latency and throughput across various model sizes, helping developers compare AMD hardware against prior Intel‑focused results. It integrates with existing llama.cpp scripts and is open‑source.

highlights.title: Security updates for Thursday
highlights.summary: Thursday security updates were released for AlmaLinux, Debian, Fedora, Mageia, and Oracle, including kernel and major package patches.
highlights.detail: Updates address CVEs across networking, graphics, and runtime components; administrators should apply them promptly to maintain system integrity.

highlights.title: A Modular 6502 Computer
highlights.summary: Hackaday featured a modular 6502 computer design that revives the classic microprocessor in a compact, extensible board.
highlights.detail: The project provides schematics and firmware for hobbyists, enabling easy integration of peripherals and serving as a teaching platform for low‑level hardware concepts.

highlights.title: Another Split Flap Display You Can Print Yourself
highlights.summary: A printable split‑flap display design is shared, reviving the mechanical alphanumeric boards once common in airports and clocks.
highlights.detail: The project provides source files and assembly instructions so hobbyists can fabricate their own display using 3D‑printed parts and off‑the‑shelf components. It highlights the nostalgic aesthetic while offering a low‑cost, customizable alternative to electronic screens.

highlights.title: Diagnosing a Failed LG Fridge Ice Maker
highlights.summary: A step‑by‑step guide explains how to troubleshoot and repair a failed ice‑maker in an LG refrigerator.
highlights.detail: The article outlines common failure points such as clogged water lines, faulty sensors, and motor issues, and provides diagnostic tests and part replacements. It aims to help owners avoid service calls by performing the repair themselves.

items.detail: Built on a compact transformer architecture, the model balances quality and speed for multimodal captioning, and is distributed in a standard repository format.

items.title: Scientific Analysis of Nontraditional Garden Watering Method
items.summary: An analysis evaluates the performance of an unconventional garden‑watering method that relies on passive water collection.
items.detail: The study compares water usage, plant health metrics, and maintenance effort against traditional irrigation, finding comparable moisture levels with reduced municipal water demand. It discusses scalability and potential adaptations for different climates.
